summary.en: Local zfr-core gateway as a Magpie provider: multi-egress IP rotation, retry and rate-limit layer in front of OpenCode Zen / Kilo free models. Requires `zfr serve` on the same machine.
summary.zh: 把本机 zfr-core 网关接成 Magpie provider：在 OpenCode Zen / Kilo 免费模型前面加多出口 IP 轮换、重试与限流层。需要本机先跑 `zfr serve`。
